fib: ______ is the risk of a decline in investment returns because of market factors independent of the given security or property investment.
Market risk
Market risk is the risk of a decline in investment returns because of market factors independent of the given security or property investment.
______ is concerned with assessing the general state of the economy and its potential effects on security returns.
Economic analysis
Economic analysis is concerned with assessing the general state of the economy and its potential effects on security returns.
______ is an essential element in the buying and selling of common stock.
Keeping track of current prices
Keeping track of current prices is an essential element in the buying and selling of common stock.
______ is made up of income earned on the job as well as most other forms of non-investment income.
Active income
Active income is made up of income earned on the job as well as most other forms of non-investment income.
______ are a term used to describe put and call options traded on organized exchanges rather than over-the-counter market.
Listed options
Listed options are a term used to describe put and call options traded on organized exchanges rather than over-the-counter market.
______ are an example: An investor essentially buys the opportunity to sell or buy another security or asset at a specified price during a given period of time.
Options
Options are an example: An investor essentially buys the opportunity to sell or buy another security or asset at a specified price during a given period of time.
______ are a unique type of security because they are not issued by the organizations that issue the underlying stock or financial asset.
Put and calls
Put and calls are a unique type of security because they are not issued by the organizations that issue the underlying stock or financial asset.
______ is a stock that has a prior claim (ahead of common stockholders) on the income and assets of the issuing firm.
Preferred stock
Preferred stock is a stock that has a prior claim (ahead of common stockholders) on the income and assets of the issuing firm.
______ are the most popular type of investment company.
Open-end mutual funds
Open-end mutual funds are the most popular type of investment company.
______ means looking at such things as its makeup and basic characteristics, the key economic and operating variables that drive industry performance, and the outlook for the industry.
Analyzing an industry
Analyzing an industry means looking at such things as its makeup and basic characteristics, the key economic and operating variables that drive industry performance, and the outlook for the industry.
______ is an investment made in a portfolio or collection of securities or properties, typically constructed to meet one or more investment goals.
indirect investment
An indirect investment is an investment made in a portfolio or collection of securities or properties, typically constructed to meet one or more investment goals.
______ is the risk of not being able to liquidate an investment conveniently and at a reasonable price.
Liquidity risk
Liquidity risk is the risk of not being able to liquidate an investment conveniently and at a reasonable price.
______ is the mechanism for bringing together suppliers of extra funds with demanders who need funds.
investment process
The investment process is the mechanism for bringing together suppliers of extra funds with demanders who need funds.
______ are the financial objectives you wish to achieve by investing in any of a wide range of potential investment instruments.
Investment goals
Investment goals are the financial objectives you wish to achieve by investing in any of a wide range of potential investment instruments.
______ is an equity investment that represents ownership in a corporate organization.
Common stock
Common stock is an equity investment that represents ownership in a corporate organization.
______ are referred to as fixed -income securities because the debt-service obligations of the issuer are fixed.
Bonds
Bonds are referred to as fixed -income securities because the debt-service obligations of the issuer are fixed.
______ is the actual date on which the firm will mail dividend cheques to holders of record.
payment date
The payment date is the actual date on which the firm will mail dividend cheques to holders of record.
______ is a special type of fixed income obligation.
convertible security
A convertible security is a special type of fixed income obligation.
______ is a negotiable, long-term debt instrument that carries certain obligations (including the payment of interest and the repayment of principal) on the part of the issuer.
bond
A bond is a negotiable, long-term debt instrument that carries certain obligations (including the payment of interest and the repayment of principal) on the part of the issuer.
______ is the case when interest rates fall.
reverse
The reverse is the case when interest rates fall.
______ are a group of investment instruments that offer fixed periodic return.
Securities having fixed-income
Securities having fixed-income are a group of investment instruments that offer fixed periodic return.
